note: Farming notes are for reference only. Check local agricultural guidance.

0.name: Sohan
0.summary: The cold settles in for good
0.description: The first solar term of the year, when the cold becomes severe and fields begin to freeze.
tasks: Check insulation in barns and storage rooms.
Watch winter crops for frost damage.

1.name: Daehan
1.summary: The coldest stretch of the year
1.description: The coldest period of the year, when snow and cold keep most field work on hold.
tasks: Store vegetables and seeds where they will not freeze.
Drain water from farm machinery and keep it indoors.

2.name: Ipchun
2.description: The start of spring, when days grow longer and frozen ground begins to thaw.

3.name: Usu
3.description: Snow and ice melt into rain, thawing the ground and leaving the soil wet.

4.name: Gyeongchip
4.description: Hibernating insects awaken as the ground fully thaws and pests begin to stir.
tasks: Prepare pest control for fruit trees.

5.name: Chunbun
5.description: Day and night are of equal length, and spring plowing and sowing begin in earnest.

6.name: Cheongmyeong
6.description: Skies turn clear and bright as flowers bloom and rice-planting preparations peak.
tasks: Watch for frost while fruit trees are in bloom.

7.name: Gogu
7.description: Spring rain nourishes the grain, and the soaked soil is ready for rice planting.

8.name: Ipha
8.description: Summer begins, temperatures rise, and crops grow quickly.
tasks: Plant field crops such as peppers and soybeans.

9.name: Soman
9.description: Crops fill the fields as rice planting ends and weeding begins.
tasks: Manage water in case of drought.

10.name: Mangjong
10.description: Barley and wheat are harvested while rice is planted, making this one of the busiest seasons.

11.name: Haji
11.description: The longest day of the year, when rice and field crops grow fast and pests increase.
tasks: Manage water in the rice paddies.

12.name: Soseo
12.description: The heat sets in, with the rainy season and hot spells alternating.
tasks: Keep rice and field crops well watered.

13.name: Daeseo
13.summary: The hottest stretch of the year
13.description: The hottest period of the year, hard on both people and crops.
tasks: Keep shallow water in the paddies to protect rice.
Ventilate barns and keep water available.

14.name: Ipchu
14.description: Autumn begins and mornings and evenings turn cooler.
tasks: Watch the rice come into ear.
Prepare to plant cabbage and radishes for kimjang.

15.name: Cheoseo
15.description: The heat recedes as autumn harvest and kimjang preparations begin.
tasks: Plant cabbage and radishes for kimjang.

16.name: Baengno
16.description: Dew forms as night temperatures drop and grain ripens.
tasks: Clean up the remaining field crops.

17.name: Chubun
17.summary: Day and night are equal again
17.description: Day and night are equal again as the main autumn harvest begins.

18.name: Hallo
18.description: Cold dew forms as morning temperatures drop sharply and the autumn harvest is in full swing.
tasks: Check cabbage and radishes for kimjang.
Cover crops that are sensitive to frost.

19.name: Sanggang
19.description: Frost begins to fall, with cold mornings and evenings and the first ice in some places.
tasks: Get ready to pull and store cabbage and radishes for kimjang.
Prepare plastic sheeting and frost cloth for cold nights.

20.name: Ipdong
20.description: Winter begins, and families make kimjang and prepare for the cold season.
tasks: Check next year's seeds and fertilizer.

21.name: Soseol
21.description: The first snow falls as the ground freezes and stored winter vegetables need attention.
tasks: Service farm machinery and keep it indoors.

22.name: Daeseol
22.description: Heavy snow falls, so greenhouses and barns need checking for snow load.

23.name: Dongji
23.description: The longest night of the year, a time to share red bean porridge and plan the year ahead.
tasks: Share red bean porridge and close out the year.
Watch winter crops for frost damage.
